title: Lords of the Night
notes: 21 world bosses: every world now has its own boss with its own name, look and tricks, ending with the Moth Queen at the Hollow Moon.
A boss health bar at the top of the board shows each boss's name, title, shield and health.
Tutorial: new players get a short guided first run. Skip it any time, or replay it from How to play or Settings.
Balance: gentler early bosses, about 50% more embers per wave, 5 embers per boss, more gold in deeper worlds, and +20% embers and XP for every prestige.
